skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand, analyze and apply general knowledge about international trade law.
Understand, analyze and apply knowledge about international contract laws including sales contracts, service contracts, and investment contracts.
Understand, analyze and apply knowledge about dispute resolution mechanisms in international trade.
Apply skills to approach, research, identify and resolve legal issues arising from international business relations.
Apply negotiation and drafting skills when participating in international business relations, especially in international sales contracts, service contracts, and investment contracts.
Apply presentation and group work skills.
Develop independent study skills to accumulate and enhance professional knowledge and experience.
Understand planning and implementation skills, coordination, and collective intelligence.
